content.summary: The negative controls substantiate specific audit rejection behavior, with the appropriate limited interpretation. Manuscript and canonical snapshot hashes match; no revision is required for this audit-method claim.

checks.method: Read auditRoot and all three isolated control sources; recomputed their SHA256 hashes and compared their recorded compiler diagnostics.
checks.observation: All three source hashes match. The controls respectively name an absent declaration, audit a definition, and derive False from an explicitly disallowed axiom. Each receipt records exit one with its corresponding rejection marker. The audit checks existence, theorem kind, proposition type, and collected transitive axioms before emitting pass. The controls test three rejection paths, not every possible failure mode, and do not independently establish theorem truth or dependency integrity. The manuscript accurately keeps them outside the protected proof closure.
